# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia m158 engine update** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews the Skia m158 engine while preserving the existing managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300; the bundled HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158** — Updates the bundled renderer from Skia m157 to m158 without changing managed wrappers, generated bindings or C API declarations. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine with the existing managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 without upgrading the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
